one_line: A Malabar coast pharmacopoeia merchant trading medicinal spices across the Indian Ocean in the early centuries CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, lean but sturdy build from travel and port labor.
appearance.face: Oval face with warm medium‑brown complexion, faint sun freckles, straight nose, neatly trimmed mustache and short beard along jawline; sharp, observant eyes with a calm, calculating default expression.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied into a short topknot at the back of the head, sides smoothly combed; a narrow off‑white cotton headband wraps around the forehead, knotted at the back with small ends hanging.
appearance.costume: Era‑accurate early historic south Indian trader outfit: an off‑white, ankle‑length cotton dhoti wrapped tightly and pleated in front with a brown woven border; a light, knee‑length, long‑sleeved cotton tunic in muted indigo blue worn over the dhoti, side‑slit at the hips for ease of movement; a thin, cream‑coloured angavastram (shawl) with a narrow red stripe along both edges draped from the left shoulder across the torso and around the back; simple leather sandals with toe loops; minimal jewellery limited to one small gold earring in the left ear and a plain copper bangle on the right wrist, suggesting modest prosperity without royal ostentation.
appearance.signature: A medium‑sized rectangular woven palm‑leaf basket carried by a leather shoulder strap, its lid slightly open to reveal neatly tied cloth bundles of peppercorns, long pepper, nard roots and small ceramic jars; a narrow wooden tally board with notches is lashed to the basket’s side.

ref_desc: Samudra‑Vaidya is a lean, medium‑brown Malabar trader with a short black topknot and off‑white headband, wearing an indigo long‑sleeved tunic over an off‑white bordered dhoti and cream shawl, carrying a palm‑leaf medicinal basket with visible spice bundles.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character sheet of Samudra‑Vaidya, an early centuries CE Malabar pharmacopoeia merchant: a lean, medium‑brown man in his late 20s with an oval face, straight nose, neat mustache and short jawline beard, sharp thoughtful eyes, and thick black hair tied into a short topknot with an off‑white cotton headband around his forehead. Show him in an era‑accurate south Indian trader costume: an ankle‑length off‑white cotton dhoti with a brown woven border, wrapped and pleated in front; over it a light, knee‑length, long‑sleeved indigo blue cotton tunic with side slits at the hips; a cream angavastram shawl with a narrow red stripe along both edges draped from his left shoulder across his torso and around his back; simple leather sandals with toe loops; one small gold earring in his left ear and a plain copper bangle on his right wrist. His signature prop is a medium rectangular woven palm‑leaf basket on a leather shoulder strap, lid slightly open to show tied cloth bundles of pepper, long pepper, nard roots and small ceramic jars, with a narrow wooden tally board lashed to the side. Use a palette of off‑white, indigo blue, brown, cream and red, and pose him neutrally front, side and back so his face, hair, clothing and basket are all clearly visible for consistent redrawing.
